method.setup: Three legal manual65/refill batches. Each65-step extraction advances one month after60steps. Fill months1/3/5. First manual1 unlocks an equally hired bottler in all arms; that stored bottle is not sold. All comparisons start at identicalmonth5 core state.
method.policy: Age6/count10 or stockthreshold5/count10. Explicitly delegate0/1/3 first casks. Traditional arm uses existing reserveBottling once per chosen cask; shared arm saves common policy once then delegateBottling per chosen cask. Untouched casks use equivalent manual partial work. Remaining casks are manually finished atage12. Shop offers declined to isolate bottle work, no cash/age/stock injection.
method.pair: Same seed, same requested and actual jobs, same monthly chemistry/sales/fees/upkeep/wages. Entire economic projection hashes must match each old/shared pair. Manual-only vs delegated work may differ by legitimate bottler wages, reported separately; no economic tuning.
method.operationUnits: Actual model commands are counted from recordedoperations. Shared adds one set-policy command and does not claim fewer model commands. Conceptual UI control actions exclude common navigation: old each chosen cask sets3 active values(mode,age-or-threshold,count)+confirm; shared sets those3values+save once, then one explicit opt-in per cask. These are defined conceptual units, not measured phone taps; field selections count even when a remembered default happens to match. Phone evidence is separate.
